{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("Checking for thousands separators in revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum(), "rows contain commas")

# Inspect the revenue values more closely
print("\nSample of revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:15])

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# But only if needed — the sample shows no commas
# So we can safely cast without removing commas
# But let's double-check: are there any commas?
if df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any():
    df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

print("\nConverted revenue range:", df['revenue_numeric'].min(), "to", df['revenue_numeric'].max())"}
